entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'd like to start a return for an Urban Commuter Helmet I purchased a while back.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01B. The thing is, the box is still unopened. I ordered it as a gift, but the color just wasn't what they wanted.
I understand completely. Let me pull that up for you. VF886-01B... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the helmet was delivered 69 days ago.
That sounds about right. Is that going to be a problem?
Not at all. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can process this return for you right now.

Of course. Your satisfaction and safety are our main priorities. I've just initiated the return and you should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack it up and drop it at any shipping center.
Perfect. Now, since I'll be ordering a different model, and given that the color on the website was a bit misleading, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

Let me see what I can do for you. Yes, I see here that you're one of our VIP customers. As a thank you for your loyalty, I can absolutely offer you a 15% discount code for your next order. I've just added it to the return confirmation email.
A 15% discount is fantastic. That's more than fair. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks again for calling VeloFit.
